test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the number of calculators sold by two shopkeepers L and M in 5 months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/212baa44ce470287251a1140370a7742367bff8ae632089dcca31232cd83cd39.png] 

J1 = The value of the average number of calculators sold by L in all the months.

J2 = The difference between the total number of calculators sold by L and M.

What is the value of (J2/J1) ?
solution:
**Calculation:**

J1 = The value of the average number of calculators sold by L in all the months.

(350 + 340 + 320 + 315 + 305)/5 = 326

J2 = The difference between the total number of calculators sold by L and M.

Total number of calculators sold by L = 350 + 340 + 320 + 315 + 305 = 1630

Total number of calculators sold by M = 305 + 310 + 360 + 330 + 325 = 1630

J2 = 1630 - 1630 = 0

so, J2/J1 = 0/326 = 0

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
